summary: Cardiol Therapeutics filed a Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited condensed interim consolidated financial statements, MD&A, and CEO/CFO 52-109F2 certifications for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026 — a routine Canadian interim reporting package mapped to a US quarterly report equivalent. No transaction, stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural/regulatory terms appear; disclosures show cash of C$29.2M, deficit of C$243.3M, and net loss of C$30.2M for the nine months. Not a special situation; watch only for financing needs given ongoing burn.
